game.title: The First Berserker: Khazan
game.blurb: Action game from Neople, released 2025-03-27. RAWG average playtime: 73 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Khazan's journey, boss by boss and mission by mission. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Endings and the Second Journey

chapters.title: Bonus Missions and Exploration
chapters.summary: Bonus missions, Danjin's jarlings, collection items, special scrolls, ghosts and wandering souls.

chapters.title: Smithing, Lacrima and Trade
chapters.summary: Crafting and dismantling with Qazumaka, Oksana's attributes and Lacrima, Duimuk's shop and gear.

chapters.title: Combat and Skills
chapters.summary: Brutal attacks, breakfalls, the javelin, the Blade Phantom pact, stats and combat skills.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub). Its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls, Enemies and "Achievements and trophies" pages are linked but not written; the only written subpage is "Table of Contents". thefirstberserkerkhazan.fandom.com and thefirstberserker.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; khazan.fandom.com has a page for the game with no linked pages; nothing copied. The Steam schema names the game "The First Berserker: Khazan" (app 2680010). 29 of 57 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions, so they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; achievements 1 to 24 fall in unlock rate from 90% to 31% and read like story bosses or missions, and 49 to 52 and 57 ("THE FIRST BERSERKER") may be late or ending goals. "Fully Equipped" (a piece of gear in every slot) landed in smithing because of the word gear. RAWG lists a playtime of 73 hours, which looks high.
